remarks: Multiple Offers Received - Highest & Best Due Monday March 24th by 6 PM. Charming, sun-drenched, and impeccably maintained, this Sears Dover home in Norwalk boasts incredible curb appeal and thoughtful updates throughout. Featuring 3 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and an oversized two-car detached garage, this home seamlessly blends classic character with modern convenience. Inside, gleaming hardwood floors flow throughout the spacious main level, which includes an oversized living room with a fireplace, a formal dining room, and an updated kitchen with granite countertops, newer stainless steel appliances, and custom wooden cabinetry-perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. A large third bedroom and updated powder room complete the first floor. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, both with walk-in closets, and a beautifully renovated full bathroom. The living space extends outdoors with an enormous upgraded screened-in porch overlooking the professionally landscaped, private backyard. This home has been extensively upgraded, including new central air, 200-amp electrical service, a Culligan water system, SmartLock, Ring doorbell, and Simply Safe security system. Additional updates include plantation shutters, new lighting, an expanded kitchen footprint and a newly repaved driveway. The front porch and walkway have been updated with bluestone, and a lawn & garden sprinkler system ensures effortless maintenance.
